exposure: before vs. after MDT first-aid simulation training
outcome: neonatal intensive care unit admission rates
cohort: 149 UCP cases (48 overt and 101 occult) and 298 control deliveries
finding: The study found that multiparity, breech presentation, polyhydramnios, and low birth weight were independent risk factors for overt UCP, while preterm labor and abnormal placental cord insertion were risk factors for occult UCP.
mod_finding: After MDT first-aid simulation training, patients with overt UCP experienced shorter decision-to-delivery intervals due to more timely cesarean sections, and their newborns had higher Apgar scores and lower NICU admission rates.
